title: Proximity and the Management of Innovation
authors: Chloe Kim Glaeser; Stephen Glaeser; Eva Labro
eligible_reason: Giroud (2013)-style first-difference design, not TWFE: outcomes are IHS changes in three-year averages (ihs_change_*_3avg), the treatment tequals0 is a 0/1 indicator for a significant travel-time decrease in the current year only (non-absorbing event-year dummy, post_all is defined only in that year), and fixed effects are firm-by-year and state-by-year (file_year#gvkey, file_year#state_num) with no inventor or facility FE. Facility regressions also include the time-varying control change_num_inventors_w.
design_notes: Inventor-year (InventorAnalyses.dta, 2.3 GB) and facility-year (FacilityAnalyses.dta, 173 MB, 35,184 rows; analysis sample 13,162 rows, 4,629 gvkey-MSA units, 1995-2007, 530 treated unit-years) panels. Table 2 regresses levels on ihs_distance; Tables 3-5 regress changes on tequals0 with reghdfe absorb(file_year#gvkey file_year#state_num) and multi-way clustering; sample drops travel-time increases (tequals0_term != 1) and movers. Table 6 is a determinants regression. Units have a median of 2 observations, so a unit-FE event study is not what the paper reports.
estimators_reported: first-difference OLS with firm-year and state-year FE (reghdfe)

ineligible_specs.reason: first-differenced outcome, non-absorbing event-year treatment, no unit FE; time-varying control in facility panels

screener_notes: The package directory holds only two zip files and no extracted content; the regressions list is empty. mnsc.2022.4469.zip (173 MB) is a truncated download. _archive_mnsc.2022.4469.zip (827 MB) is a complete zip64 archive that macOS unzip rejects ('End-of-central-directory signature not found') but bsdtar (tar -xf) and Python zipfile read correctly. I extracted Final Tables.do, readme.pdf, firmlevel.dta and FacilityAnalyses.dta to the session scratchpad for screening; nothing was written to the package directory.
